role: Dental radiography clinical audit reviewer, working through individual exposure episodes for a multi-surgery dental group's radiation protection audit
setting: Each record is one radiographic episode from a dental surgery: the referral and justification entries, the logged exposures, the image quality grading, the X-ray unit's QA status and console log, and the operator's audit history. The reviewer reconciles these sections, weighs documented exceptions and equipment context, and decides justification, retake cause, follow-up, dose position and unjustified exposure count. There are no free-text fields; all evidence is in coded values, numbers, dates and flags.

justified.instructions: The exposure was clinically justified by the recorded referral details.

criteria.true: Indication code and recall interval support the requested view
criteria.false: Indication missing, mismatched to view, or interval too short

operator_retake.instructions: The retake was caused by operator technique, not equipment or patient.

criteria.true: Fault codes and equipment checks point to operator technique
criteria.false: No retake, or equipment, patient or unclear cause

follow_up.instructions: What follow-up should the auditor assign to this exposure record?

criteria.close_record: No discrepancies, or all fully explained; audit closes without action.
criteria.log_trend: Trivial unexplained discrepancy; recorded for trend review, no contact.
criteria.hold_confirm: One missing confirmation or sign-off must arrive before closing.
criteria.operator_feedback: Confirmed technique or justification error; operator receives targeted feedback.
criteria.escalate_rpa: Unmitigated dose, equipment or repeated exposure breach referred to adviser.

dose_position.instructions: Where does the verified patient dose sit against the reference level?
criteria: Low: verified dose below 75% of reference level
Raised: verified dose above 100%, up to 150%
Excessive: verified dose above 150% of reference level

unjustified_count.instructions: How many logged exposures lack a matching justified request?
criteria: Every logged exposure matches a justified request
Exactly one logged exposure lacks a justified request
Exactly two logged exposures lack justified requests
Three or more logged exposures lack justified requests

factors.name: indication_match
factors.description: How well the referral indication code fits the requested view type (e.g. caries screening code against a bitewing versus a periapical for an unrelated tooth).

factors.name: recall_interval_months
factors.description: Months since the previous radiograph of the same view and region, compared with the minimum interval implied by the recorded caries risk category.

factors.name: dose_ratio_to_drl
factors.description: True ratio of patient dose to the diagnostic reference level for the view; values near 0.75, 1.0 and 1.5 sit on scale boundaries.

factors.name: console_log_discrepancy
factors.description: Disagreement between the exposure list and the unit's console log: none, small time-stamp drift, mismatched kV or exposure time (shifting verified dose), or an extra exposure in the console log absent from the exposure list.

factors.name: retake_cause
factors.description: Underlying cause of any repeat exposure, signalled indirectly by image fault codes, sensor error entries and patient flags.

factors.name: equipment_qa_status
factors.description: State of the X-ray unit's periodic QA at exposure date: in date, overdue, failed last output test, or operating under a logged service visit.

factors.name: approved_exception
factors.description: A documented clinical override (e.g. prescriber-approved shorter recall for symptomatic patient or higher-dose setting for large patient) exists, mitigating interval or dose concerns.

factors.name: patient_cooperation_flag
factors.description: Patient record flags limited cooperation, gag reflex or special care need, offering a benign explanation for movement or positioning faults.

factors.name: unrequested_exposure_count
factors.description: Number of logged exposures that do not correspond to any requested view before mitigation by verbal authorisation.

factors.name: verbal_authorisation_logged
factors.description: A timestamped prescriber authorisation entry covers additional exposures, turning otherwise unrequested exposures into justified ones when its time and view match.

factors.name: image_grade
factors.description: Recorded diagnostic quality grade of the final image after any retake.

factors.name: audit_completeness
factors.description: Whether all audit inputs are present: complete, image grading pending second reviewer, or operator sign-off missing.

factors.name: operator_prior_findings
factors.description: Count of prior confirmed audit findings for the operator in the last 12 months, raising weight of a new technique error.

sections.name: request
sections.description: Referral: requested views, indication code, caries risk category, prescriber id, request date, prior same-view date, exception and verbal authorisation entries.

sections.name: exposures
sections.description: List of logged exposures with view, region, kV, mA, exposure time, recorded dose estimate, timestamp and retake_of reference.

sections.name: image_review
sections.description: Final image grade, fault codes per image, second grader status, sensor error codes.

sections.name: equipment
sections.description: Unit id, last QA date, QA interval, last output test result, service log entries, view reference levels, console log entries.

sections.name: operator
sections.description: Operator id, role, sign-off timestamp or null, prior findings count, last training date.

rendering_notes: indication_match: request.indication_code against request.views_requested; never labelled as matching. recall_interval_months: derived from request.prior_same_view_date versus request.request_date, compared with request.caries_risk (high allows 6 months, moderate 12, low 24). dose_ratio_to_drl: exposures[].dose_est_mGy against equipment.drl_ref[view]; the auditor must compute the ratio, and where console_log_discrepancy is setting_mismatch the console kV/exposure_s imply a different verified dose than the exposure list, so equipment.console_log values govern. console_log_discrepancy: equipment.console_log[] entries compared with exposures[] by timestamp, kV and time; timestamp_drift is under 2 minutes and benign; extra_console_exposure adds an entry with no exposure-list counterpart, which also counts as unjustified. retake_cause: exposures[].retake_of set non-null, with image_review.fault_codes (e.g. FC_APEX_CLIPPED, FC_CONE_CUT, FC_BLUR, FC_OVER_DENSE) and image_review.sensor_errors; sensor_fault shows a sensor error code at the retake timestamp; patient_movement shows FC_BLUR, ambiguous when patient_cooperation_flag is absent. equipment_qa_status: equipment.last_qa_date plus qa_interval_months versus exposure date, equipment.last_output_test (pass/fail), equipment.service_log with open visit window. approved_exception: request.exceptions[] entry with code and approver id, or empty list. patient_cooperation_flag: request.patient_flags list (e.g. GAG_REFLEX, SPECIAL_CARE). unrequested_exposure_count: exposures whose view/region is absent from request.views_requested; verbal_authorisation_logged appears as request.verbal_auth[] with time and view, and only covers exposures with matching view and later timestamp, so sometimes it covers some but not all. image_grade: image_review.final_grade (1/2/3 coded). audit_completeness: image_review.second_grader_status 'pending' or operator.signoff_at null. operator_prior_findings: operator.prior_findings_12m. Decoys: equipment.unit_serial, room id, sensor size, patient age band, operator.last_training_date (usually unrelated), and timestamp_drift entries that look like discrepancies but are harmless. No field may state justification, retake cause attribution, dose percentage, unjustified count or recommended action; no summary, risk or outcome fields. Mismatches are never flagged by the record itself.
